name: use-item-noop
comment: use_item that does nothing: a right click on the top of a stone platform block (Block has no blockActivated override, Block.java:506-508) with an empty hand (placed false, used false, stack null), then holding a stick (item 280; Item.onItemUse returns false and Item.onItemRightClick returns the stack, Item.java:155-165, Item.java:298), so the slot keeps {280,1,0}. Pins the op line and that the op draws nothing from world.rand.
